metadata.title: System Security Plan: sample-azure (SC-28 + SC-28(1) only)
metadata.remarks: Thin SSP for the steel thread: only the components and controls needed for SC-28 and SC-28(1). The Azure SQL Database component is copied from component-definitions/azure-sql-sc28 (same uuid, for traceability). This SSP holds the system-specific decisions only: the sc-28_odp.01 selection, the inventory and the implementation status. Organisation parameter values are inherited from the imported organisation profile.

system-characteristics.description: Sample web application: an Azure Static Web App backed by an Azure SQL Database, defined in main.bicep in the frictionless-sample-azure repository (cloned at ../sample-azure). Production is deployed by that repository's GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml), which runs deploy.sh when a version tag (v*) is pushed or the workflow is run by hand.

information-types.title: Application data
information-types.description: Data the application stores in the appdb Azure SQL database.

authorization-boundary.description: The resources declared in main.bicep: the Static Web App and its app settings, the Azure SQL logical server, its firewall rule and the appdb database. Only the database is in scope for this steel thread.

system-characteristics.remarks: The sample's realistic categorisation is Low. It is treated as Moderate here because SC-28 and SC-28(1) first appear in the NIST MODERATE baseline.

users.title: Database administrator
users.description: The SQL administrator login (dbAdminUsername) declared in main.bicep. Its password is held as the DB_ADMIN_PASSWORD secret of the repository's GitHub production environment.

users.title: GitHub Actions deployment identity
users.description: Non-person identity that deploys production: a Microsoft Entra app registration whose federated credential trusts only GitHub OIDC tokens from the repository's production environment, so no keys are stored. Created by setup-github-deploy.sh.

authorized-privileges.title: Contributor on the resource group
authorized-privileges.description: Azure built-in Contributor role, scoped to the system's resource group.
functions-performed: Deploy main.bicep (including the appdb database) and the Static Web App content

components.title: Azure SQL Database
components.description: Azure SQL logical server and database. Data at rest (data files, transaction logs and backups) is encrypted with Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), which is enabled by default for new databases. A database created as a ledger database (isLedgerOn) additionally SHA-256 hashes every change into a Merkle-tree blockchain whose digests are stored outside the database, making tampering detectable; ledger can only be set when the database is created.

links.text: Copied from the Azure SQL Database component definition

inventory-items.description: Azure SQL database appdb on logical server sql-tier-<uniqueString> (Microsoft.Sql/servers/databases in main.bicep). Not declared as a ledger database; TDE is not declared, so the Azure default (enabled, service-managed key) applies.

control-implementation.description: SC-28 and SC-28(1) for the sample-azure application data, implemented by the Azure SQL Database component.

set-parameters.remarks: Both selected, as the organisation profile's constraint requires.

by-components.description: Confidentiality: appdb is encrypted at rest by TDE (Azure default, service-managed key). Integrity: appdb was not created as a ledger database, so changes to stored data are not tamper-evident.

implementation-status.remarks: Confidentiality is implemented; integrity is not, because appdb is not a ledger database.

by-components.description: sc-28.1_obj-1 (disclosure): implemented by TDE (AES-256) on appdb's data files, transaction logs and backups. sc-28.1_obj-2 (modification): not implemented; appdb is not a ledger database, and ledger can only be enabled when a database is created.

implementation-status.remarks: obj-1 implemented; obj-2 planned (new ledger database and data migration).
